payload.name: Retrieve recommendations without recipient and with time range
payload.description: Use when a question asks what a person recommended/suggested/advised to another person (e.g., which city/book X recommended to Y). Retrieve without requiring the recipient in memory and use a time range for month/year phrases.
content: If a question asks for a recommendation/suggestion/advice given by one person to another, run a search using only the recommender's name and recommendation verbs (recommended, suggested, advised, mentioned) plus the object type, without requiring the recipient's name to appear in the memory.

When the question includes a time period like a month or year (e.g., 'in January 2024'), use a time range covering the whole period instead of a point at the start, so memories dated anywhere in that period are eligible.

If the first search yields no evidence, do not conclude 'No information available'; retry with the recommender and object keywords only, and inspect events from that person that lack the recipient's name.

solves: Questions about what one person recommended/suggested to another often fail because the stored memory omits the recipient's name and the search over-requires it. Also, a month/year phrase may be treated as a point time, missing events later in that period. This applies to future recommendation/suggestion questions with a recipient and a temporal range, not to interest-based recommendation generation.
